summary: Trust Wallet launched Pokémon Gacha packs with Collector Crypt this week, and it took over packs talk on X, with creators calling it a 'wallet gacha war' next to Renaiss Gacha in Binance Wallet. One tracker counted $1.66M of Collector Crypt machine spend in 24h: $758k direct, $616k via Trust Wallet, $141k via Jupiter, $57k via Slabz (Solflare was not in that list). Black Friday brought sold-out Pokémon shelves and long lines at retail. Solflare Packs talk was steady and positive, mostly ambassador explainers of the $99 Everything Pack and pull posts.
